tbesh_html:
Combined with me.shekh (מֶ֫שֶׁךְ "Meshech" H4902I)
§ Tubal = "thou shall be brought"
a region in east Asia Minor
perhaps nearly equal to Cappadocia

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity
strongs_1890.derivation: or תֻּבַל; probably of foreign derivation;
